topics.title: HL7 FHIR Core Resources (Patient, Observation, Condition)
topics.objective: Model clinical patient data using interoperable, standardized FHIR JSON schemas and coding systems.
topics.exercise: Construct a valid FHIR Observation payload recording a patient blood pressure reading with LOINC codes.

topics.title: Clinical Decision Support & Drug-Drug Interaction Engines
topics.objective: Audit proposed medication orders against patient allergy lists and contraindication knowledge graphs.
topics.exercise: Build an interaction checking rule engine alerting clinicians when prescribing Warfarin with NSAIDs.

topics.title: Laboratory Information System (LIS) Interface & HL7 v2 Feeds
topics.objective: Ingest automated diagnostic laboratory test results and update patient charts seamlessly.
topics.exercise: Parse an incoming HL7 v2 ORU^R01 message and map numeric lab values into structured patient chart records.

topics.title: SMART on FHIR & OAuth2 Scoped Healthcare Access
topics.objective: Authorize external healthcare apps using clinician-scoped and patient-scoped OAuth2 tokens.
topics.exercise: Implement a SMART on FHIR authorization server granting read-only access to lab results.

topics.title: Immutable Medical Record Versioning & Tamper Evident Logging
topics.objective: Preserve complete clinical chart revision histories with tamper-evident cryptographic hash chains.
topics.exercise: Implement an append-only medical record versioning manager preventing retroactive note alteration.
